summary: Frontend-only verification of the QRU Founder Experience Principle™ — Knowledge picker (topic-first) across Poster Studio, Storyboard Studio, and Enterprise Manufacturing Dashboard. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS. Founder never sees KMR codes, UUIDs, or version tokens anywhere in these manufacturing surfaces.

issues: Persistent React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — emergent editor injects a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside the product-type <select>. Cosmetic/console-only; functionality unaffected.

critical_code_review_comments: KnowledgePicker.js: reloads /media-studio/knowledge-manufacturing every time the dialog opens for a fresh mount (`useEffect` guarded by `krs.length` — OK for one component instance). However Poster and Storyboard studios each mount their own KnowledgePicker independently → two identical KR fetches per page. Consider a shared/cached fetcher (SWR/react-query) to avoid duplicate network round-trips when the founder toggles between studios.

KnowledgePicker.js: `filtered` filters only on `k.topic`. If two KRs share the same topic (e.g. verified vs draft of same topic — currently visible in the picker as 'What Is Governance? · Verified' and 'What Is Governance? · Draft'), the founder cannot distinguish them beyond the Verified/Draft chip. Consider showing a subtle status prefix or grouping (e.g. section header 'Verified' / 'Drafts') to reduce ambiguity — the Founder Principle is 'never make them remember internal IDs', but they still need enough signal to pick the correct record.

PosterStudio.js: `generate()` reads `selTmpl?.factual` after using it — declared with `const selTmpl = templates.find(...)` further below (line 62). Works only because JS hoists `const` in the closure at call-time, but visually the reference precedes the declaration. Move the derivation above `generate` for readability.

PosterStudio.js: `payload.kr_id = form.kr_id || null` — the backend `/publishing/poster/generate` accepts nullable kr_id (unverified template default flow), but Storyboard's `run()` `if (!krId) return toast.error(...)` correctly guards. Consistent behaviour; documented for next agent.

KnowledgeManufacturing.js:24-33: initial `.catch()` now logs to console (fixed since iter_58) but still shows only a toast — an unauthenticated founder gets 'Could not load Knowledge Records' with no path forward. Consider redirecting to /login on 401.

KnowledgePicker.js: sort places verified above drafts (good) but relies on booleans → all drafts appear after all verified. Within-group ordering is stable/insertion-order from the API — no client-side alphabetical secondary sort. Founder now sees 'What Is Governance?' twice (verified then draft) with the second entry visually a duplicate; consider prefixing draft rows or hiding drafts by default (verifiedOnly=true default) on founder-facing manufacture surfaces.

Each item shows the topic + 'N products manufactured' + Verified/Draft chip only — verified via regex there is ZERO occurrence of KMR-XXXXXX / UUID / vN tokens in the dialog, in the trigger label, on the KM page left list, or in the selected-KR header. Overrides are collapsed by default, expand via data-testid=poster-overrides-toggle, and every override field has placeholder 'Inherited from Knowledge' with empty value. Storyboard Studio picker (data-testid=storyboard-knowledge-*) behaves identically — no legacy <select> element remains on the page. Enterprise Manufacturing Dashboard header now reads 'What Is Governance? — Living Manufacturing Dashboard' (no KMR-1A93CE or v3 tokens). Regression: km-manufacture-all-btn present, 4 Coming Soon cards, 4 PDF download links, Project Zero panel visible.
